descriptions.text: This one almost struck a nerve. Eleven.finance, a yield aggregator on Binance Smart Chain (BSC) and Polygon (MATIC) was exploited for a total of $4.5M.

Incorrect logic flow Vulnerable code snippet: https://bscscan.com/address/0x27dd6e51bf715cfc0e2fe96af26fc9ded89e4be8?a=0xa5c29d44817551aa499260ab9640584bf124d4b7#code#L1131 In emergencyBurn function, we can see incorrect logic, withdraw token but without burning token. So attacker can withdraw again after calling emergencyBurn.

Nerve Finance, a stablecoin trading platform based on the Binance Smart Chain (BSC), tweeted that the Nerve-related machine gun pool in the revenue aggregator Eleven Finance have been attacked by sparks. After analysis, the reason for the exploit is that the emergencyBurn() function does not calculate the balance correctly and does not execute the destruction. On September 30th, hackers have returned approximately $4.5 million in stolen funds.

On June 22, 2021, Eleven Finance on BNB Chain was exploited for about $4.8 million after a bug in the emergencyBurn function allowed attackers to withdraw assets without burning vault shares, enabling multiple withdrawals and draining affected vaults. The emergencyBurn function in custom Nerve-derived vaults transferred assets out without burning the caller’s vault shares, allowing repeated withdrawals against the same share balance.
